name: lfi-meta-chart
description: Smoke-audit the LFI meta_chart binary's HTML output (Phase A.4). Loads a pre-generated chart HTML file (produced by `meta_chart --format html --out lfi-meta-chart.html`) and verifies it renders without console errors / failed assets / CSP violations. Run after any change to src/bin/meta_chart.rs or src/intelligence/meta_measurements.rs.
